title: aragallus montanus
intro: Aragallus montanus, commonly known as Mountain Sneezeweed, is a flowering plant species in the family Boraginaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its health benefits in treating respiratory issues, such as allergies and congestion. The plant is known to exhibit therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help soothe and calm the respiratory system. The bioactive constituents of Aragallus montanus include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
